about: Scott B. Smith is a managing partner at the law firm Smith, Ball & Baez Injury Lawyers located in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, and serves clients throughout Florida with an emphasis on South Florida and the Treasure Coast. He represents people whose rights have been violated by the carelessness and negligence of others and concentrates his practice on personal injury cases.

The types of cases Mr. Smith takes on involve car accidents, truck accidents, wrongful death, catastrophic injuries, motorcycle injuries, boat accidents, product liability, slip-and-fall accidents and medical malpractice matters. He is a fierce defender of people who have suffered harm due to no fault of their own. He is board-certified by The Florida Bar Board of Legal Specialization & Education as a specialist in civil trial law.

Mr. Smith attended Florida State University and obtained his bachelor’s degree in political science and literature, graduating with dean’s list honors. He continued at the Florida State University College of Law to study law and received his Juris Doctor in 1998. Between 1991 and 1993, he served in the U.S. Air Force.
Involved in the legal community actively, memberships in well-known legal organizations are held by Mr. Smith, including:
· The Florida Bar and its Code and Rules of Evidence Committee
· Florida Justice Association, Board of Directors member
· Palm Beach County Justice Association, Board of Directors member
· Palm Beach County Bar Association, Chair
· Palm Beach County Bar Association’s Personal Injury/Wrongful Death CLE Committee

Licensed to practice law in Florida, Mr. Smith is authorized to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Middle, and Southern Districts of Florida, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court. He has served as lead or co-counsel in a number of instances that ended in settlements or jury verdicts totaling more than $1 million.

Mr. Smith has been selected to the Florida Top 100 List. Attorneys on the top list have been selected to the 2023 Florida Super Lawyers List and ranked top of the list in the Super Lawyers selection process.

Mr. Smith has appeared in various legal periodicals for his notable work in the personal injury field, including Palm Beach Illustrated, Best Lawyers and Attorneys at Law Magazine. He has also received the highest peer-review rating of AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell and has a “Superb” rating on Avvo.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
